## How it was tested
<!-- Which suites did you run? Anything touching the browser path needs e2e. -->
- [ ] `pytest test/unit` passes
- [ ] `pytest test/e2e` passes (or n/a — no browser path touched)

## Checklist
- [ ] Change is focused and matches surrounding style (types annotated, no stray reformatting)
- [ ] If this adds/changes a write action, it stays default-deny and allowlist-and-label gated
- [ ] Docs/README updated if user-facing behavior changed
